_description: TY2025 Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT) parameters under IRC §55. AMT rarely binds for NRA students with low income but must be checked for full Form 6251 compliance. Source: IRS Rev. Proc. 2024-40 Section 3.10.

phaseout_threshold._note: AMT exemption phases out by 25 cents for every $1 of AMTI above threshold.

rate_kink._note: AMTI below the kink is taxed at 26%; above is taxed at 28%.
